'''Nyris Ko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], she and her family member [[Icarr Ko]] joined Doctor [[Alirra Semhess]]' group of rogue Republic scientists who worked on a secret project on the [[X7-Cratus]] space station. Eternal Alliance operatives under [[Theron Shan]] eventually discovered Semhess and her project and a strike team was dispatched to X7-Cratus to stop [[RS-33]] adrenal from becoming a galactic threat. Alliance forces engaged and defeated Marlon Fenn, but during their fight the station's containment systems were damaged and [[RAK-5 serum]] started leaking into atmosphere. Icarr and Nyris Ko engaged the intruders in the infected state and after turning into [[rakghoul]]s mid-fight, both were killed the Alliance personnel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nyris Ko appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Trial and Error" Uprising.
